home.seo_intro_title: AI character chat that starts from real scenes
home.seo_intro_body: Keepsay is a free AI character chat home for people who want an AI friend, a fictional crush story, an adult campus classmate, a roommate character chat, a comfort companion, or a fantasy adventure that can continue tomorrow. The memory layer keeps concrete details like your favorite drink, the last scene, a nickname, or a small promise, while Quick Create lets you make your own private character from that starting point.
seo_intro_points: Free chat, anime school stories, and fantasy roleplay from one canonical home
Characters can remember your story, nickname, favorite drink, and last scene
Create a private AI character instead of starting from a blank prompt
home.seo_faq_title: Questions people usually ask before trying Keepsay

seo_faqs.question: What is Keepsay?
seo_faqs.answer: Keepsay is an AI character chat and roleplay app for people who want free chat, story continuity, memory, and fast private character creation.

seo_faqs.question: What should I open first?
seo_faqs.answer: Start with the English home page, then choose AI friend chat, anime school story, roommate roleplay, fictional crush chat, fantasy adventure, comfort companion, or create your own character.

seo_faqs.question: What does memory change in character chat?
seo_faqs.answer: Memory lets a character pick up the last scene, keep a nickname, remember a favorite drink, and continue a story instead of starting every chat from zero.

quick_create.title: Quick Character Create
quick_create.headline: Pick a few feelings. AI fills the rest.
quick_create.subtitle: Use a story setup, character traits, and one optional memory to make a chat-ready character in minutes.
quick_create.required_hint: Required: choose a scene and at least 1 trait. Everything else is optional; defaults are already selected.

quick_create.audit_blocked: Publish audit did not pass. Open advanced edit to fix it.
quick_create.no_preview: Complete the first four steps to generate a preview.
quick_create.memory_label: What should they remember at the start? (optional)
quick_create.memory_placeholder: Example: They owe me an explanation.

quick_create.custom_scene_placeholder: Write your own scene, such as: my quiet tattoo artist neighbor.

quick_create.image_prompt_placeholder: Optional image note, such as: silver hair, raincoat, warm cafe light

create.image_style_suffix_help: Appended to every portrait prompt so all renders of this character share the same medium, palette, lighting, and framing. AI Writer fills it for you — most creators never need to edit it.
create.image_style_suffix_placeholder: e.g. anime illustration, warm amber and ink-black palette, soft window backlight, 3:4 portrait single subject
create.voice_preset_help: AI Writer recommends a TTS tone from the character's gender, core traits, and speaking style. You can override it before saving.
create.style_examples_help: Few-shot user/character turns that teach the model this character's cadence, action formatting, and emotional response pattern.
create.style_example_user_placeholder: User line, e.g. You disappeared again.
create.style_example_character_placeholder: Ideal character reply in this character's voice.
create.skill_desc: Supports additional capabilities like image generation and song creation, expanding character story use cases
create.image_prompt_placeholder: For example: rainy city street, same character, black trench coat, cinematic lighting, change only the scene and pose, keep the same face and hairstyle

create.voice_desc: Choose a voice preview for your character
create.tags_help: Pick one or more categories so your character shows up in the matching tab.
create.persistence_line: Drafts persist locally for guests and in the database after sign-in.
create.notice: Notice: Everything characters say is made up by AI!
